caption: Fig. 4. (a) QCCD architecture of TIQC, which connects 1D traps with 4-way junctions. It supports ion shuttling and swap. (b-e) The collective ion swap between (1,3) and (2,4) using ion shuttling. (f) 2Q gates (CNOT) are performed on the qubits within the same trap.

templates.why_chosen: Six-panel grid (a)-(f) with a shared six-entry legend below, and a dashed box grouping (b)-(e) as the expansion of (a).
templates.what_to_learn: A dashed box around a sub-grid says 'these panels expand that panel'; the shared legend below is defined once for all six. Note: the PDF-extracted print.png includes a line of surrounding body text; use preview.png for the clean figure.

templates.why_chosen: Panels (b)-(e) are near-identical small multiples of the same ion-trap grid, boxed in a dashed 2x2 group that zooms into the shuttle steps behind panel (a)'s single collective-swap overview, with orange arrows tracing each step.
templates.what_to_learn: When more than four panels are needed for a step-by-step breakdown, group the small-multiple steps into their own dashed 2x2 box rather than spreading all panels across one row, and keep every step's grid icon pixel-identical so only the orange shuttle arrow's position changes between them.
